#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class CF1187G {
public:
    CF1187G() {}
    
    class InputReader {
    private:
        const static int BUFFER_SIZE = 1 << 15;
        unsigned char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
        int bufferIndex, bufferLength;
        FILE* inputStream;
        
    public:
        InputReader(FILE* is) : inputStream(is) {
            bufferIndex = 0;
            bufferLength = 0;
        }
        
        int readByte() {
            if (bufferIndex >= bufferLength) {
                bufferLength = fread(buffer, 1, BUFFER_SIZE, inputStream);
                bufferIndex = 0;
                if (bufferLength <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[bufferIndex++];
        }
        
        int readInt() {
            int ch;
            while ((ch = readByte()) <= 32) if (ch == -1) return -1;
            int value = 0;
            while (ch > 32) {
                value = value * 10 + ch - '0';
                ch = readByte();
            }
            return value;
        }
    };
    
    InputReader* reader;
    
    static const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    vector<vector<int>> adjacency;
    int totalNodes, totalEdges;
    vector<int> potential, distance, predecessor;
    vector<int> edgeStart, edgeEnd, edgeXor, edgeWeight;
    vector<int> edgeCapacity;
    
    void prepare(int nodes, int edges) {
        adjacency.assign(nodes, vector<int>());
        potential.assign(nodes, 0);
        distance.assign(nodes, 0);
        predecessor.assign(nodes, 0);
        edgeStart.assign(edges, 0);
        edgeEnd.assign(edges, 0);
        edgeXor.assign(edges, 0);
        edgeWeight.assign(edges, 0);
        edgeCapacity.assign(edges * 2, 0);
        totalEdges = 0;
    }
    
    void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
        int idx = totalEdges++;
        edgeStart[idx] = from;
        edgeEnd[idx] = to;
        edgeXor[idx] = from ^ to;
        edgeWeight[idx] = cost;
        edgeCapacity[idx * 2] = cap;
        adjacency[from].push_back(idx * 2);
        adjacency[to].push_back(idx * 2 + 1);
    }
    
    vector<int> queueArray;
    int queueStart, queueEnd, queueCount;
    vector<bool> inQueueFlag;
    
    void pushToQueue(int node) {
        if (inQueueFlag[node]) return;
        if (queueStart + queueEnd == (int)queueArray.size()) {
            if (queueCount * 2 <= (int)queueArray.size()) {
                memmove(queueArray.data(), queueArray.data() + queueStart, queueCount * sizeof(int));
            } else {
                vector<int> temp(queueArray.size() * 2);
                memmove(temp.data(), queueArray.data() + queueStart, queueCount * sizeof(int));
                queueArray = temp;
            }
            queueStart = 0;
        }
        queueArray[queueStart + queueEnd++] = node;
        inQueueFlag[node] = true;
    }
    
    int popFromQueue() {
        int node = queueArray[queueStart++];
        queueCount--;
        inQueueFlag[node] = false;
        return node;
    }
    
    bool findShortestPath(int source, int sink) {
        fill(potential.begin(), potential.end(), INF);
        potential[source] = 0;
        queueStart = queueEnd = 0;
        pushToQueue(source);
        
        while (queueCount > 0) {
            int current = popFromQueue();
            int newDist = distance[current] + 1;
            
            for (int edgeIndex : adjacency[current]) {
                if (edgeCapacity[edgeIndex] > 0) {
                    int edgeId = edgeIndex >> 1;
                    int cost = (edgeIndex & 1) == 0 ? edgeWeight[edgeId] : -edgeWeight[edgeId];
                    int newPotential = potential[current] + cost;
                    int neighbor = current ^ edgeXor[edgeId];
                    
                    if (potential[neighbor] > newPotential || 
                        (potential[neighbor] == newPotential && distance[neighbor] > newDist)) {
                        potential[neighbor] = newPotential;
                        distance[neighbor] = newDist;
                        predecessor[neighbor] = edgeIndex;
                        pushToQueue(neighbor);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return potential[sink] != INF;
    }
    
    void augmentFlow(int source, int sink) {
        int minCapacity = INF;
        for (int node = sink; node != source; node ^= edgeXor[predecessor[node] >> 1]) {
            minCapacity = min(minCapacity, edgeCapacity[predecessor[node]]);
        }
        for (int node = sink; node != source; node ^= edgeXor[predecessor[node] >> 1]) {
            int idx = predecessor[node];
            edgeCapacity[idx] -= minCapacity;
            edgeCapacity[idx ^ 1] += minCapacity;
        }
    }
    
    void augmentUnitFlow(int source, int sink) {
        for (int node = sink; node != source; node ^= edgeXor[predecessor[node] >> 1]) {
            int idx = predecessor[node];
            edgeCapacity[idx]--;
            edgeCapacity[idx ^ 1]++;
        }
    }
    
    int calculateMinCostFlow(int source, int sink) {
        while (findShortestPath(source, sink)) {
            augmentUnitFlow(source, sink);
        }
        int totalCost = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < totalEdges; i++) {
            totalCost += edgeWeight[i] * edgeCapacity[i * 2 + 1];
        }
        return totalCost;
    }
    
    void execute() {
        reader = new InputReader(stdin);
        
        int n = reader->readInt();
        int m = reader->readInt();
        int k = reader->readInt();
        int c = reader->readInt();
        int d = reader->readInt();
        
        vector<int> special(k);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            special[i] = reader->readInt() - 1;
        }
        
        vector<vector<int>> graph(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) graph[i] = vector<int>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = reader->readInt() - 1;
            int v = reader->readInt() - 1;
            graph[u].push_back(v);
            graph[v].push_back(u);
        }
        
        int timeSteps = k + 1;
        int totalVertices = n * timeSteps + 1;
        int totalEdgesCount = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (timeSteps - 1);
        
        prepare(totalVertices, totalEdgesCount);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < timeSteps - 1; t++) {
                int u = i * timeSteps + t;
                for (int neighbor : graph[i]) {
                    int v = neighbor * timeSteps + t + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                        addEdge(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < timeSteps - 1; t++) {
                int u = i * timeSteps + t;
                int v = u + 1;
                addEdge(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            addEdge(totalVertices - 1, special[i] * timeSteps, 1, 0);
        }
        
        cout << calculateMinCostFlow(totalVertices - 1, 0 * timeSteps + timeSteps - 1) << endl;
        
        delete reader;
    }
};

int main() {
    CF1187G instance;
    instance.execute();
    return 0;
}
